title: Learning by doing, with science at the centre
lead: A full secondary curriculum from JSS1 to SS3, with laboratory work, competitions and practical skills built in.

curriculum.heading: Six years, three national exams
curriculum.text: Students sit BECE at the end of JSS3, and WASSCE and NECO at the end of SS3.

stages.name: Junior Secondary
stages.text: Broad foundation in sciences, mathematics, languages and vocational skills. [SAMPLE wording]

stages.name: Senior Secondary
stages.text: Science focus: Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Further Maths and ICT. [CONFIRM subjects]

labs.heading: Four labs, used every week [SAMPLE frequency]
labs.text: Practical work is part of every science course. [DRAFT]

items.name: Physics
items.text: Optical benches, lenses and prisms, metre bridges, circuits, galvanometers and projectile kits. A mechanics zone has pulleys, pendulums and timing devices. [DRAFT]

items.name: Chemistry
items.text: Digital balances, pH meters, burner arrays, distillation units and fume chambers, with fire-safety provisions and eyewash stations. Students do titrations and qualitative analysis. [DRAFT]

items.name: Biology
items.text: Microscopes and slides, organ models and microtomy kits. Food tests, dissection, ecological surveys and osmosis experiments. [DRAFT]

items.name: ICT
items.text: Digital simulations and virtual experiments, computer-based testing (CBT) practice and multimedia learning tools. [DRAFT]
